stories.title: Trump'ın Grönland anlaşması, mağlubiyet ilanına dönüştü

en.title: Trump's Greenland agreement turned into announcement of defeat
en.summary: US President Donald Trump signed a new agreement to expand US military presence in Greenland, though the excerpt does not clarify details regarding property transfer.

stories.title: 11 ülke çöl için harekete geçti: 8 kilometrelik ağaç duvarı çekiyorlar

en.title: 11 countries take action for desert: they are pulling an 8-kilometer tree wall
en.summary: Eleven countries are implementing the Great Green Wall project across the Sahel region in Africa to combat desertification and land degradation.

stories.title: Adalar Belediye Başkanvekili Kemal Türkyılmaz kimdir?

en.title: Who is Islands Municipality Deputy Mayor Kemal Türkyılmaz?
en.summary: Kemal Türkyılmaz was elected as Deputy Mayor of Islands Municipality, and public interest surrounds details about his background and identity.

en.title: OECD raised Turkey's inflation forecast
en.summary: The OECD revised downward its growth forecasts for Turkey in 2026 and 2027 while simultaneously raising its inflation projections.

stories.title: OECD'den Türkiye ekonomisi için kötüleşen görünüm: Büyüme tahmini düştü, enflasyon beklentisi yükseldi

en.title: OECD presents worsening outlook for Turkey's economy: growth forecast falls, inflation expectations rise
en.summary: The OECD revised downward its growth forecasts for Turkey in its September Economic Outlook report, lowering expectations for 2026 and 2027 while raising inflation projections for the same periods. Global economic growth forecast was increased to 2.9 percent from 2.8 percent.

stories.title: Isparta’da dehşet! Eşini sokakta pompalı tüfekle öldürdü

en.title: Horror in Isparta! He killed his wife with a shotgun on the street
en.summary: A man fatally shot his wife with a shotgun on a street in Isparta's Şarkikaraağaç district following an argument, as she was leaving to go to her father's house.

stories.title: İçişleri Bakanı Mustafa Çiftçi'den Manisa'daki okul saldırısına ilişkin yeni açıklama

en.title: Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi makes new statement regarding school attack in Manisa
en.summary: Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi stated that necessary judicial and administrative procedures are being conducted carefully to fully clarify all aspects of the school attack in Manisa.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… Başkan Erdoğan ve Akın Gürlek ile fotoğrafını oluşturmuştu! Yapay zeka başına iş açtı!

en.title: BREAKING NEWS… He had created a photo with President Erdoğan and Akın Gürlek! Artificial intelligence caused problems!
en.summary: Authorities launched an investigation following notable shares made via WhatsApp in Ankara involving AI-generated photographs of President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and Justice Minister Akın Gürlek.

stories.title: İçişleri Bakanı Mustafa Çiftçi’den emniyet müdürlerine 10 maddelik talimat

en.title: Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi Issues 10-Point Directive to Police Directors
en.summary: Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi met with newly appointed police directors and issued them instructions. The newly appointed directors were tasked with assessing peace and security conditions in their assigned provinces within the first 30 days.

stories.title: Isparta'da sokak ortasında cinayet: Eşini pompalı tüfekle vurdu

en.title: Murder in Isparta Streets: Man Shoots Wife with Shotgun
en.summary: A man fatally shot his wife with a shotgun in the street in Şarkikaraağaç district after an argument. The suspect was detained and the couple's two children were placed under protection.

stories.title: Ankara'da yapay zeka manipülasyonu: Kamu görevlileriyle yan yana fotoğraf paylaşıp gözaltına alındı

en.title: Artificial Intelligence Manipulation in Ankara: Man Detained for Sharing Manipulated Photos with Public Officials
en.summary: A 53-year-old man was arrested in Ankara for using artificial intelligence to insert his photo next to images of the President and Justice Minister, then sharing them on social media. The suspect had four prior criminal records.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA! Adalar Belediyesi AK Parti'ye geçti! Kemal Türkyılmaz Başkanvekili oldu

en.title: BREAKING! Adalar Municipality Switches to AK Party! Kemal Türkyılmaz Becomes Deputy Mayor
en.summary: Following the resignation of Deputy Mayor Medine Pamuk due to health reasons, the municipal council convened to elect a new deputy mayor, with Kemal Türkyılmaz selected for the position.

stories.title: ÖSYM üzerinden 2026 DGS ek tercihler ne zaman alınacak?

en.title: When will 2026 DGS supplementary preferences be accepted through ÖSYM?
en.summary: Bachelor's degree candidates await notification about supplementary preferences for the 2026 DGS examination. Thousands of applicants check daily for an announcement regarding when the application period will begin.

stories.title: Türkiye'nin bal üretiminde 2026 tahmini belli oldu

en.title: Turkey's honey production forecast for 2026 announced
en.summary: Turkish beekeeping officials project honey production of 97-100 thousand tons in 2026, based on approximately 9 million hives currently in operation. Final production figures will be confirmed after the pine honey harvest concludes.

stories.title: İstanbul Kültür Yolu Festivali başlıyor: 9 gün boyunca konserler, sergiler ve gastronomi rotalar

en.title: Istanbul Culture Road Festival begins: nine days of concerts, exhibitions and gastronomy routes
en.summary: The Istanbul Culture Road Festival will run from September 26 to October 4, 2026, featuring performances by domestic and international orchestras, ballet groups and Turkish artists. The nine-day program includes concerts, exhibitions, theater performances, children's activities and food-related attractions.

stories.title: Bakır rekora yeniden yaklaştı: Arz sıkıştı, dolar fren yaptı

en.title: Copper approaches record again: supply tightens, dollar brakes rally
en.summary: Copper prices near historic highs following a six-day rally, supported by tight physical supplies in China and increased stockpiling demand in the US. A stronger dollar and expectations of additional interest rate increases are limiting further gains.

stories.title: Kuraklık nikeli vurdu: Endonezya'da 70 bin tonluk kayıp riski

en.title: Drought hits nickel: Indonesia risks 70,000-ton loss
en.summary: Water shortage triggered by El Niño is forcing production cuts at Indonesia's Morowali nickel facilities, the world's largest nickel producer. Potential two-week losses could reach 50,000 to 70,000 tons, pushing nickel prices higher.
